contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= t <= 10**4","description":"The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= n <= 10**5","description":"The number of strings n in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(1 <= len(s) <= 8 for s in strings)","description":"Each string s_i must have a length between 1 and 8."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(s.islower() for s in strings)","description":"All strings must consist of lowercase English letters."},{"id":"P5","expression":"sum(n for _ in range(t)) <= 10**5","description":"The total number of strings across all test cases must not exceed 100,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout) == t","description":"The output must contain exactly t binary strings, one for each test case."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(len(binary_string) == n for binary_string in stdout)","description":"Each binary string must have a length equal to the number of strings n in the corresponding test case."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(c in '01' for binary_string in stdout for c in binary_string)","description":"Each character in the binary strings must be either '0' or '1'."},{"id":"Q4","expression":"all((stdout[i][j] == '1') == any(s[i] == s[j] + s[k] for j in range(n) for k in range(n)) for i in range(t) for j in
